newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Royal Bank cut at NatWest.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Royal Bank cut at NatWest.

text.p: Earnings estimates for Royal Bank of Scotland Plc were cut at NatWest Securities, market sources said on Thursday.
For the current year NatWest reduced its estimate for pre-tax profit to 665 million stg from 700 million and for next year it cut to 707 million stg, though no comparison was immediately available.
Sources said the reduction mainly reflected a squeeze on profits at the bank's Direct Line telephone insurance unit.
Analyst Mark Eady at the brokerage declined comment.
The stock was up 1p at 488p by 1028 GMT.
